XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for the Course sync block

TABLE.NAME: block_coursesync_pulls
TABLE.COMMENT: Live ledger of what each block instance has pulled: one row per remote course module, recording where it landed locally and the change signals seen at the last successful pull.

FIELD.NAME: blockinstanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The block instance this pull belongs to

FIELD.NAME: remotecmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id on the remote site

FIELD.NAME: localcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id the activity was restored into locally

FIELD.NAME: remotesignal
FIELD.COMMENT: Remote change signal recorded at the last successful pull

FIELD.NAME: remotesignalmethod
FIELD.COMMENT: How the remote signal was derived: timemodified or hash

FIELD.NAME: localsignal
FIELD.COMMENT: Change signal of the local copy immediately after the pull, used to detect later local edits

FIELD.NAME: localsignalmethod
FIELD.COMMENT: How the local signal was derived: timemodified or hash

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: synced, conflict or skipped

FIELD.NAME: conflictreason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the row is in conflict, when it is

FIELD.NAME: timepulled
FIELD.COMMENT: When this activity was last successfully pulled

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When this ledger row last changed

TABLE.NAME: block_coursesync_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Append-only audit trail: one row per activity processed in a sync run, grouped by run id.

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: Groups all rows written by a single sync run

FIELD.NAME: blockinstanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The block instance the run belongs to

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who triggered the run

FIELD.NAME: remotecmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id on the remote site

FIELD.NAME: localcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Local course module id, once one exists

FIELD.NAME: modname
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity module type

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity name as it was on the remote site

FIELD.NAME: outcome
FIELD.COMMENT: new, updated, unchanged, conflict or error

FIELD.NAME: message
FIELD.COMMENT: Detail for conflicts and errors

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When this row was written
